content.short: PlutosDAO provides plutusDAO, a layer-2 governance protocol that strives to maximize rewards and liquidity.
content.description: PlutosDAO centers on plutusDAO, an Arbitrum-native Layer-2 governance protocol that aggregates governance around the PLS token with the aim of maximizing users' liquidity and rewards. The project intends to become the default Layer-2 governance protocol for initiatives built on veTokens (valueless governance tokens). To broaden its product offering, plutusDAO has partnered with other protocols to launch new governance products and is expanding its toolkit to include Vaults, alongside ongoing enhancements to the core platform.
